context_requirements: Active integrin/focal adhesion signaling with FAK (PTK2) expression and autophosphorylation at Y397
Adherent growth on matrix; FAK dependence is strongest in cells with high FAK activity or Merlin (NF2) loss
Proliferative or survival signaling through FAK-SRC-PI3K/MAPK for growth-inhibitory or apoptotic consequences
E-cadherin-low / mesenchymal phenotype for sensitivity to FAK-inhibitor-induced apoptosis
falsifiers: No decrease in PTK2 or PTK2B mRNA at 6 h or 24 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h in any line
No induction of apoptosis or stress-response genes at 24 h in any line
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines, including non-adherent or FAK-low contexts
Clear response at 6 h that is not sustained or amplified at 24 h

evidence.supports: FAK inhibitor PF-573,228 inhibits FAK Y397 phosphorylation and focal adhesion turnover but does not inhibit growth or induce apoptosis, suggesting limited transcriptional response
FAK inhibitor TAE226 inhibits FAK phosphorylation and cell growth in ovarian carcinoma lines
FAK inhibitor PF562271 suppresses proliferation, induces apoptosis, and downregulates AKT/mTOR in osteosarcoma
FAK inhibitor VS-4718 sensitivity in Merlin-negative mesothelioma depends on low E-cadherin and apoptosis induction
FAK inhibitor TAE226 affects HCC growth and tumour-promoting gene expression, with epigenetic effects
